company.name: Great Question
company.shortDescription: Great Question is a customer research platform designed to automate research tasks and gain consumer insights.
company.description: Great Question is a customer research platform designed to automate research tasks and gain consumer insights. Great Question allows its users to recruit participants, run their preferred methods, and synthesize and share their findings all in one collaborative platform.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that manages the entire UX research process including participant recruitment, scheduling, interviews, surveys, prototype testing, and research repository management.
productsAndServices.name: Great Question User Research Platform

productsAndServices.description: Tools to find, recruit, and manage research participants from internal CRM data or an external panel of over 3 million B2B and B2C candidates.
productsAndServices.name: Participant Recruitment and Panel Management

productsAndServices.description: A scheduling system tailored for research that coordinates interviews, focus groups, and continuous discovery sessions with features like candidate waitlists and time proposals.
productsAndServices.name: Research Scheduling and Calendar Management

productsAndServices.description: A centralized repository that stores all research data and uses AI to generate summaries, extract insights, themes, and quotes for easy querying and sharing.
productsAndServices.name: Research Repository with AI-Powered Synthesis

productsAndServices.description: A set of tools supporting various UX research methods such as user interviews, surveys, prototype testing, card sorting, and tree testing.
productsAndServices.name: Suite of Research Methodology Tools

productsAndServices.description: A feature to send incentives to research participants globally to thank them for their participation in studies.
productsAndServices.name: Incentive Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $13,000,000, or 83.87% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,990,143 to $62,179,300, a 10.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 79 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Dovetail, User Interviews, UserTesting.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
